name: hud_ui_zrd_widget_ex17c_item_on_activate_select_self
description: HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C_Item::OnActivateSelectSelf selects its owner option, activates the owner selector and item, then hides previews on every owner option through the item ftable.
known_limits: Tier C only; Binary Ninja still records a limited reconstruction note because HLIL renders the options loop as byte-offset slot arithmetic.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b87f0 validates SetSelectedIndex(ownerSelector, itemIndex), owner ftable slot 0x30 activation, direct HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate on the item, and a signed optionCount loop dispatching each option ftable slot 0x40.
Binary Ninja data for g_HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C_Vtbl and g_HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C_Item_Vtbl validates selector slot 12 and item slots 12, 15, 16, 30, and 31 ownership used by this contract.

The native smoke verifies selected-index update, owner activation ftable dispatch, item activation state, custom child hide-preview ftable dispatch, normal selected-child preview behavior, and the modeled Ex17C table slots.
